changes.result: Every path component is compared with .codex-worktree using portable ASCII case-insensitive comparison. Program, cwd, artifact, worktree-root, descriptor-open, and tree-walk entry points reject or prune before open. Lowercase, uppercase, title-case, and nested mixed-case canaries use isolated dummy fixtures only.

The pure repository/worktree equality and protected-component checks now run before LiveContext revalidation or RootAnchor open. Alternate repository/worktree roots reject with an exact root-owned device/inode binding requirement.

Without an accepted typed-catalog binding, production CommandSpec rejects every caller-classified public argument, environment entry, and artifact. It also rejects every effect except Read. No sensitive-looking-name heuristic remains, and secret values are never inferred.

The only surviving production behavior is a Read, pre-requested-interruption, zero-spawn observation with no public argv, environment, or artifact inputs. Explicit bound secret inputs serialize source name and public version only; target execution remains unavailable.

CapturedArtifact canonical JSON now includes immutable content_sha256, exact byte_length, context_id, candidate_id, relative path encoding, store_identity immutable-memory-arc-v1, and resolver_identity none. In-memory bytes and the internal PathBuf are excluded.

Production public artifact capture fails before RootAnchor construction. Artifact mechanics are reachable only through a cfg(test) helper for adversarial verification and cannot create a production bypass.

Descriptor reads accept an explicit maximum, reject oversized metadata before allocation or read, never consume beyond the initial bounded length, and recheck metadata after read. Artifact capture applies a 4 MiB per-file and 8 MiB aggregate logical-content ceiling before each initial read.

Thread-local test instrumentation records descriptor bytes consumed. A rejected 5 MiB artifact records zero consumed bytes; a third 3 MiB artifact is rejected at the remaining aggregate bound after only the first two bounded artifacts are read and validated.

No LiveContext identity schema, root device/inode authority, root wiring, Cargo dependency, public witness, generated catalog, migration registry, claim registry, package, or release surface was modified.
